title: Šalta kambaryje
text: Kambarys 412 visą naktį buvo šaltas, radiatorius vos šiltas. Registratūroje pasakė, kad atsiųs techniką, bet niekas neatėjo. Pusryčiai geri, personalas mandagus, bet už tokią kainą tikėjausi daugiau.

title: Aer condiționat stricat
text: Aerul condiționat din cameră nu a funcționat deloc, iar afară erau 34 de grade. Am cerut altă cameră, dar hotelul era plin. Nu am dormit aproape deloc.

title: Soggiorno perfetto
text: Hotel nuovissimo, camere pulite e silenziose, colazione abbondante. Il personale alla reception è stato gentilissimo. Torneremo sicuramente!

title: Brak ciepłej wody
text: Rano przez ponad godzinę nie było ciepłej wody w całym piętrze 3. Obsługa przeprosiła, ale nikt nie wiedział, kiedy problem zostanie naprawiony. Spóźniłem się na spotkanie.

title: Great location
text: Very central, quiet room, comfortable bed. Breakfast could have more vegetarian options, but overall excellent value.

title: WLAN unbrauchbar
text: Das WLAN im Zimmer war praktisch nicht nutzbar, ständig Verbindungsabbrüche. Für Geschäftsreisende ein No-Go. Ansonsten sauber und freundliches Personal.

title: Am primit un șoc electric!
text: La duș, când am atins bateria, am simțit un curent electric. Este extrem de periculos! Am anunțat recepția (camera 318) și mi-au spus că verifică mâine. Inacceptabil.

title: Puikus aptarnavimas
text: Labai malonus personalas, kambarys švarus, lova patogi. Ypač ačiū registratūros darbuotojai Ievai už rekomendacijas, kur pavakarieniauti.

title: Noisy at night
text: The room faced the street and the windows don't seem to insulate at all. Trams until 1 am and from 5 am. Staff offered earplugs, which says it all. Breakfast was good.

title: Good but elevator
text: Nice hotel, but one elevator was out of order for our entire 3-night stay and the other one was very slow. With kids and luggage it was a pain.

title: Nice stay
text: Clean, modern, friendly staff. The only issue: the TV remote did not work and nobody replaced the batteries even after asking twice.

title: Infiltrații de apă
text: A curs apă din tavan în baie toată noaptea, camera 207. Am pus prosoape pe jos. Dimineața nimeni nu știa nimic despre problemă. Ne-au oferit doar o reducere de 10%.

title: Klimaanlage laut
text: Die Klimaanlage war extrem laut, man konnte sie nicht ausschalten ohne dass es stickig wurde. Das Frühstück war hervorragend, die Lage super.

title: Excelent!
text: Totul a fost perfect: curățenie, personal amabil, mic dejun variat. Recomand cu încredere!

title: Dobry stosunek jakości do ceny
text: Pokój czysty, ale mały. Klimatyzacja działała tylko w trybie grzania, więc w nocy było za ciepło. Śniadanie bardzo dobre.

title: Excellent conference hotel
text: We held a 2-day conference here. Great AV support, coffee breaks on time, and fast Wi-Fi in the meeting rooms. Highly recommend.

title: Smell in the corridor
text: There was a strong smell of sewage in the corridor on the 2nd floor and in our bathroom. We had to keep the window open the whole time. Not what you expect from a 4-star hotel.

title: Parcare scumpă
text: Hotelul este ok, dar parcarea costă 25 euro pe noapte, ceea ce mi se pare exagerat. Camera bună, mic dejun bun.

title: Broken balcony door
text: The balcony door in our room could not be locked. We were on the 1st floor and did not feel safe. Reported it at check-in, nothing happened during 2 nights.

title: Vidutiniškai
text: Kambaryje neveikė vienas el. lizdas prie lovos, lempa mirksėjo. Smulkmenos, bet erzina. Pusryčiai labai skanūs.

title: Ottima posizione
text: Hotel in posizione centrale, personale cordiale e camere moderne. Unica pecca: la doccia scaricava lentamente.

title: Sehr gut
text: Sauber, ruhig, sehr gutes Frühstück. Die Sauna war ein schöner Bonus nach einem langen Tag.

title: Įstrigome lifte
text: Liftas sustojo tarp 3 ir 4 aukšto su mumis ir dviem vaikais viduje. Laukėme beveik 40 minučių, kol atvyko pagalba. Niekas neatsiprašė ir nepasiūlė jokios kompensacijos.

title: Good but hot room
text: Good hotel, friendly team. The room was too warm, the thermostat seemed to do nothing. A fan was brought after we asked.

title: Bellissimo
text: Camera spaziosa, letto comodissimo, staff disponibile. La terrazza per la colazione è fantastica.

title: Recepție lentă
text: Am așteptat 45 de minute la check-in, o singură persoană la recepție. Camera ok, dar prima impresie a fost foarte proastă.

title: Hałas z klimatyzacji
text: W nocy coś głośno buczało za ścianą – prawdopodobnie urządzenia techniczne na dachu. Pokój ładny, personel miły.

title: Hair in the bathroom
text: Bathroom was not properly cleaned, hair in the shower and dust under the bed. Housekeeping should do better.

title: Heizung defekt
text: Im Januar war unser Zimmer eiskalt, die Heizung funktionierte nicht. Wir bekamen einen Heizlüfter, der sehr laut war. Für den Preis enttäuschend.

title: Fantastic staff
text: Lovely staff, especially at the bar. Rooms are modern and quiet. Will come back.

title: Bun, dar Wi-Fi slab
text: Locație bună, camere curate. Internetul este foarte slab în camere, aproape inutilizabil seara.

title: Shower issues
text: Shower drain was blocked – water reached our ankles after 2 minutes. Reported twice. Fixed only on the last day.

title: Miros de fum
text: În cameră mirosea puternic a fum de țigară, deși este o cameră pentru nefumători. Am cerut schimbarea camerei, dar nu au avut disponibilitate.

title: Too cold breakfast room
text: Breakfast room was freezing, everybody was eating in their jackets. Food itself was good. Please check the heating/ventilation there.

title: Rekomenduoju
text: Labai patiko – švaru, jauku, puiki vieta. Ačiū už vėlyvą išsiregistravimą.

title: Water pressure
text: Very low water pressure in the shower and hot water took 10 minutes to arrive. For a business hotel this is not acceptable in the morning rush.

title: Ascensore rotto
text: Uno dei due ascensori era fuori servizio, e l'altro si bloccava tra i piani. Con una persona anziana è stato un problema serio.

title: Business trip – perfect
text: Fast check-in, quiet room, great desk and fast internet. Exactly what I need on business trips.

title: Iskrzące gniazdko
text: Gniazdko przy biurku iskrzyło, gdy podłączyłem laptopa, i poczuliśmy zapach spalenizny. Zgłosiłem to w recepcji (pokój 512, tel. +48 600 123 456), proszę o kontakt. To jest niebezpieczne!

title: Lärm vom Nachbarzimmer
text: Die Wände sind sehr dünn, man hört jedes Wort aus dem Nachbarzimmer. Sonst freundlich und sauber.

title: Plăcut
text: Cameră curată, personal amabil. Aerul condiționat a făcut puțin zgomot, dar nimic grav.

title: Window does not close
text: The window in room 305 did not close properly – cold draft all night and street noise. Asked to fix, they said the technician only works on weekdays.

title: Foarte bine
text: Hotel modern, mic dejun excelent, personal foarte prietenos. Recomand!

title: Puiki vieta poilsiui
text: Ramus, jaukus viešbutis. SPA zona puiki, baseinas švarus. Grįšime!

title: OK-ish
text: Room was fine but the minibar fridge was making noises all night, we had to unplug it. Location is great.

title: Hot water problem
text: No hot water in the evening – twice during a 3-day stay. Front desk said it is a known problem with the boiler. Then fix it!

title: Głośna wentylacja
text: Wentylacja w łazience była bardzo głośna i nie dało się jej wyłączyć. Spaliśmy bardzo źle.

title: Bun raport calitate-preț
text: Camere curate și spațioase. TV-ul nu avea toate canalele, iar telecomanda nu funcționa bine.

title: Wi-Fi lento
text: Hotel carino e pulito, ma il Wi-Fi in camera era lentissimo. Per lavorare ho dovuto usare il telefono come hotspot.

title: Gândaci în cameră
text: Am găsit gândaci în baie. Am fost mutați în altă cameră, dar experiența a fost dezgustătoare.

title: Świetny hotel
text: Bardzo czysto, wygodne łóżka, świetna lokalizacja blisko lotniska. Polecam!

title: Neveikė kondicionierius
text: Liepos mėnesį kambaryje neveikė kondicionierius, buvo 29 laipsniai. Atnešė ventiliatorių. Už tokią kainą – nepriimtina.

title: Recomand
text: Personal foarte amabil, cameră curată, mic dejun bun. Locație excelentă în centrul orașului.

title: Mold in bathroom
text: Black mold on the bathroom ceiling and around the shower. My daughter has asthma and we had to leave after one night. Booking ref 4481-2290, email natalia.k.travel@example.com – I expect a refund.

title: Lift and AC
text: One elevator was broken all week and the AC in room 611 was blowing warm air. Staff was helpful, but technical maintenance seems poor.

title: Gerai
text: Viskas gerai, tik pusryčiams trūko vietų ir reikėjo laukti. Kambarys švarus.

title: Inundație
text: Toaleta s-a înfundat și apa a curs pe toată podeaua camerei. Am așteptat 2 ore după cineva de la mentenanță. Nimeni nu și-a cerut scuze.

title: Good value
text: Good hotel for the price. The room heating was a bit weak, but they brought an extra blanket.

title: Top!
text: Wirklich tolles Hotel. Sehr freundliches Team, moderne Zimmer, super Frühstück. Gerne wieder.

title: Not clean
text: Stains on the bed sheets and the carpet was dirty. Changed the sheets after we complained, but it should not happen.

title: Kein warmes Wasser
text: Zwei Morgen hintereinander gab es kein warmes Wasser. Die Rezeption meinte, das sei ein Problem mit der Wärmepumpe. Sehr ärgerlich.

title: Smart TV not working
text: Smart TV kept restarting, could not watch anything. Minor thing, but annoying. Otherwise a solid hotel.

title: Zimno w pokoju
text: W pokoju było zimno, kaloryfer ledwo grzał. Dostaliśmy dodatkowy koc, ale to nie rozwiązuje problemu.

title: Tobula
text: Viskas puiku! Labai skanūs pusryčiai, švarus kambarys, maloni registratūra. Būtinai sugrįšiu.

title: Lärm von der Baustelle
text: Neben dem Hotel ist eine Baustelle, ab 7 Uhr laut. Darüber wurde bei der Buchung nicht informiert.

title: Parking gate
text: The parking barrier did not open with our card three times, we had to call reception every time. Otherwise nice stay.

title: Mizerie și aer cald
text: Aerul condiționat sufla aer cald, iar camera nu fusese aspirată. Am cerut de două ori remedierea. Dezamăgitor.

title: Lovely spa, cold pool
text: Spa area is beautiful but the pool water was really cold. Staff said the heating is being repaired.

title: Ottimo hotel
text: Camera pulita, personale molto gentile, colazione ricca. Consigliato.

title: Fire alarm at 3 am
text: Fire alarm went off at 3 am, the whole hotel evacuated in the rain. Turned out to be a false alarm. It happened again the next night! Something is wrong with the system.

title: Triukšmas iš technikos
text: Kambarys šalia technines patalpos – visą naktį ūžė ventiliatoriai. Prašėme pakeisti kambarį, bet nebuvo galimybės.

title: Excelent pentru familie
text: Am stat cu copiii, camera familie spațioasă, piscină curată. Personal amabil. Recomand!

title: Odore di muffa
text: Forte odore di muffa nella camera e nell'armadio. I vestiti hanno preso l'odore. Non accettabile.

title: Fenster undicht
text: Das Fenster war undicht, bei Regen kam Wasser herein. Wir haben es an der Rezeption gemeldet.

title: Dobra lokalizacja
text: Blisko lotniska, czysto. Wi-Fi działało słabo, a telewizor miał tylko kilka kanałów.

title: Best hotel in town
text: Fantastic service from check-in to check-out. Rooms are spotless and the bed is very comfortable. Gym is well equipped.

title: Fum în cameră
text: Am simțit miros de fum și plastic ars în cameră, de la priza de lângă pat. Am fost speriați. Recepția a trimis pe cineva abia după o oră.

title: Ok
text: Ganz okay. Das Badezimmer war etwas alt, der Duschkopf tropfte die ganze Nacht.

title: Card key issues
text: Our key card stopped working three times – had to go down to reception each time. Door lock battery maybe? Otherwise ok.

title: Kava ir pusryčiai
text: Pusryčiai labai įvairūs, bet kavos aparatas neveikė visą rytą. Kambarys jaukus, vaizdas pro langą puikus.
